skill.displayName: ZAKER news search 新闻资讯搜索
skill.summary: 基于ZAKER权威资讯库进行关键词新闻检索，支持指定时间范围。Use when the user asks about 搜索新闻, 某事件新闻, 某人物新闻, 某关键词相关新闻, 查新闻, 新闻检索, 相关新闻, 某时间段新闻.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Removed explicit mention of the 30-day time range limitation from the description and usage notes.
- Other content and functionality remain unchanged.
